name: mqtt-smarthome dimmer
description: A level item (0 = off … full scale) as a dimmable light: on/off follows the level; off sets 0, on sets the full scale, a level from the controller is scaled.

instance.label: Instance name
instance.description: The adapter instance's <name>: the first level of its topics (lgtv, hm, cul, …)

item.label: Item
item.description: The level item below status/ and set/, e.g. light/1/level

max.label: Full scale
max.description: The value the item reports for 100 % (100, 1, 255, …)

status.template: {{ 'true' if ((value_json.val if value_json is mapping else value) | float) > 0 else 'false' }}
{% set v = (value_json.val if value_json is mapping else value) | float %}{{ v * 100 / %max% if v > 0 else '' }}

command.template: {% set v = percent * %max% / 100 %}{{ v | int if v == v | int else v | round(3) }}
